text: 二〇二五財年的年報攤開，Reality Labs 那欄寫著近一百九十二億美元營業虧損。
visual: CARD

text: 手指沿同頁往下，Meta 全公司營業損益卻是正數。
visual: CARD

text: 二〇二二年，廣告送達數與單價的兩條線開始分岔，收入欄還沒掀。
visual: CARD

text: 同年十一月，Meta 宣布裁員，年底員工總數那一格卻還沒掀開。
visual: Medium view in a quiet office corridor. One complete adult office worker, with head, neck, torso, both arms and legs visible, walks past several unused chairs while carrying one plain sealed envelope. A small jar with an opaque dark cover rests on a side table; nothing inside the jar is visible. Bare walls and solid-coloured objects.

text: 隔年三月，裁員公告又來了；這一次，年底名冊會怎麼變？
visual: Medium view of the same corridor. A fresh sealed envelope sits in front of an older sealed envelope; both are blank and closed. A covered wooden box behind them keeps the future chair tokens hidden. Nothing is attached to the wall.

text: 二〇二五年，眼鏡與 Quest 的銷售線朝不同方向滑動；旁邊的虧損欄被紙片蓋住。
visual: Wide view of a clean prototype bench. Plain eyeglass frames and a generic unbranded headset shell rest beside two diverging paths of smooth gray and blue blocks. Opaque cloth hides both endpoints and the shared research-result box remains closed.

text: 一個部門虧損，Meta 為何仍有營業利益？
visual: Overhead view of a tabletop puzzle. A small brick-colored weight pulls down one side of a balance, while a larger light green weight supports the other side. The dish between them remains covered, leaving the combined result unseen.

text: 開場那筆正負同頁的帳，從二〇二一年第四季起就分成兩欄列報。
visual: Close shot of a wooden filing cabinet with two unmarked drawers sliding open side by side. One holds pale green ceramic pieces, the other rust ceramic pieces. A hand is out of frame; no folders or page surfaces appear.

text: 同一季十月，Facebook, Inc. 改名為 Meta Platforms, Inc.。
visual: Medium view of an empty boardroom shelf. One plain wooden block is carefully lifted away as another similarly sized block settles in its place. Both have perfectly smooth blank faces; the surrounding room remains the same.

text: 更名不等於 RL 當月成立；那兩欄各記什麼生意？
visual: Wide view through an archive doorway. Two smooth wooden name blocks sit on one shelf, while two distant drawers sit on another shelf with a clear gap between them. The objects for a name change stay visibly apart from the two reporting drawers.

text: 第一欄叫應用程式家族 FoA，Facebook、Instagram 等服務都在其中。
visual: Close shot at a plain service counter. Several distinct generic handset backs and small sage green ad-placement tiles flow into one open sage green tray. Every device faces away from the camera, showing only unmarked backs.

text: 第二欄是 Reality Labs，包含擴增與虛擬實境相關硬體、軟體和內容。
visual: Wide view inside a tidy research room. Plain eyeglass frames, a generic headset shell, one smooth software disc and a solid-color content sleeve occupy brick-colored shelves. No product has a label or display.

text: 兩欄攤開後，第一年的公司合計，會由哪一欄決定方向？
visual: Medium view at a wooden balance. Two identical closed ceramic jars wait beside its empty pans, their contents and weights concealed. A third opaque company-result vessel remains covered between them.

text: 每天滑過的廣告版位，正落在第一欄；廣告主付費，讓訊息出現在那些服務裡。
visual: Close shot beside an apartment window. A handset is seen from behind while a blank solid-color tile and a buyer token move toward a shallow ceramic cup. The device has no visible screen.

text: Meta 說，FoA 的收入絕大部分來自出售這種版位。
visual: Medium view of two ceramic crocks on a market table. A large sage green crock is nearly filled by identical plain ad tiles; a much smaller crock holds a few different tiles. The division is shown by the physical proportions alone.

text: 收入得先扣掉營業成本和費用；剩下的 FoA 利益，夠蓋過 RL 嗎？
visual: Overhead view of a sorting table. Ivory revenue beads enter a large carved compartment, blue expense stones are removed, and only the remaining light green beads reach a smaller uncovered compartment. Each action occupies its own clear area.

text: 二〇二一年，FoA 營業利益約五百六十九億美元。
visual: Close shot of a pale green ceramic tower made of many smooth pieces on an older shelf. It stands high above an empty shallow vessel below; the camera focuses on the tower and its clean silhouette.

text: RL 同年營業虧損約一百零二億。
visual: Wide view of a quiet research shelf. A terracotta-colored stone hangs lower than the level shelf beside plain eyeglass and headset shells, while sage green pieces remain in a compartment.

text: 合計後，全公司營業利益約四百六十八億；那張表第一次呈現清楚的正負差。
visual: CARD

text: 下一年的廣告送達數和平均價格會朝哪邊走，這個公司合計還站得住嗎？
visual: Medium view of the rear of a generic handset on a wooden market table. Two groups of ivory beads wait under small cloth covers beside a completely covered company-result bowl.

text: 開場那兩條廣告線，二〇二二年先往上的是送達數：增加百分之十八。
visual: Overhead view of two neighboring wooden trays holding identical ad-placement tiles. The newer tray contains visibly more tiles, all plain and solid-colored, while the other market props stay still.

text: 平均每則廣告的價格卻下跌百分之十六。
visual: Close shot of that market table. Many more plain ad tiles fill one tray, while a copper payment token rolls away from a smaller urn. The two movements visibly point in different directions.

text: 送得更多仍沒抵過降價，廣告收入反而比前一年少。
visual: Overhead view of a bare wooden table with only two widely separated groups of plain objects. The left group has a modest pile of smooth ivory ad tiles beside a larger pile of plain copper coins. The right group has a clearly larger pile of the same ivory ad tiles beside a smaller pile of the same plain copper coins. No people, containers, sheets, labels, symbols or writing.

text: FoA 整體收入只小幅減少，營業利益為什麼掉得更深？
visual: CARD

text: 第三季，Meta 決定縮辦公空間：部分租下的樓要轉租、提前解約或放棄。
visual: Wide view down an empty office corridor. Three untouched rooms have chairs and desks inside; three small closed model buildings sit on a nearby planning table, one offered outward, one with an open exit door, one set aside. These are proposed options, not completed moves.

text: FoA 人數增加推高薪資；開場那張裁員公告貼出後，年底公司人數真降了嗎？
visual: Medium view through an empty workroom. The newer open sage-green staffing jar contains more plain chair tokens than the older sage-green jar. A larger opaque company-wide jar remains fully wrapped beside a sealed envelope, hiding the year-end total.

text: 十二月，Meta 決定把部分資料中心建案改用新設計，另取消多個既有專案。
visual: Wide view of a construction-planning table with unbuilt miniature data-center models. Several models are rotated toward a fresh blank design made from simple blocks, while other proposed models are set aside unbuilt. No completed building appears.

text: 沒有；約一萬一千名受影響者多仍列在年末名冊，公司人數反增兩成。這些改動的重組費呢？
visual: Overhead view of a worktable. A sealed envelope lies beside a transparent jar whose chair tokens remain inside; a small rust-colored cost box stays firmly shut. The objects occupy distinct spaces.

text: 這些辦公室、裁員和資料中心重組費用列入當年，大部分記在 FoA。
visual: CARD

text: FoA 的成本與費用總額比前一年增加百分之二十二。
visual: CARD

text: FoA 營業利益因此落到約四百二十七億美元。
visual: CARD

text: 隔壁 RL 的庫存成本反而降低；它能抵住人事與研發費的上升嗎？
visual: Close shot of three smooth terracotta trays in a research room. The inventory tray grows thinner, while the people-cost and development-cost trays become fuller; a final result dish remains covered.

text: 年報說，RL 的薪資及相關費用、研發費都提高了。
visual: Medium view of an empty laboratory bench. More identical stool tokens gather beside a growing pile of plain prototype components. An earlier, smaller arrangement sits farther back for comparison.

text: 較低的庫存成本只抵銷一部分，其中包括較低的採購承諾損失。
visual: Close shot by sealed supply crates. A smaller brick-colored stone rests in the inventory tray; a second smaller stone for future commitments stays from an untouched cash basin. The crates remain closed.

text: RL 營業虧損仍擴大到約一百三十七億美元。
visual: Wide view of two neighboring rust balance pans on a table. The later pan hangs visibly lower under its added stones, although its inventory pile alone is thinner. The contrast is clear without a scale.

text: 兩欄合計，公司營業利益只剩約二百八十九億；隔年的廣告送達數還會再增加嗎？
visual: CARD

text: 二〇二三年，廣告送達數再增百分之二十八。
visual: Medium view of a quiet wooden market counter. One older tray of plain ivory ad tiles is visible; a second tray is entirely hidden under a smooth opaque cloth, with a hand paused above its edge. Solid-color walls and smooth unmarked objects.

text: Meta 說，廣告顯示得更頻繁，用戶也變多，送達數才往上。
visual: CARD

text: 平均單價卻跌了百分之九；量增價跌，收入究竟會怎樣？
visual: Overhead view of a market table. One tray gains many plain ad tiles while a copper-token cup becomes shallower; a third income cup stays covered, awaiting the result.

text: Reels 等變現率較低的版位接下更多廣告，平均單價也被壓住。
visual: Close shot of two unmarked baskets of ad tiles. More tiles move into the lower copper-token basket, and its single smooth copper payment bead sits lower than the other basket's bead. No app display is shown.

text: 這次量的力量蓋過價跌，廣告收入增加百分之十六。
visual: Overhead view of a market table. More plain ad tiles flow toward a broad later revenue bowl despite a smaller copper-price cup. The later ivory revenue bowl is visibly fuller than the earlier one, with no scale, digits or papers.

text: 開場隔年三月那張公告，計畫分三輪再裁約一萬人。
visual: Medium view of an empty company corridor. Three sealed plain envelopes sit in a neat row beside intact office chairs; a covered jar of future chair tokens remains closed. This is a plan awaiting later results.

text: 這一回到年底完成；全公司年末員工總數比前一年少兩成多。
visual: Overhead view of two transparent jars of identical chair tokens. The newer jar holds visibly fewer tokens, while the three earlier sealed envelopes now sit behind the jars in a finished stack.

text: 年末名冊變薄，行銷與銷售費用也會變嗎？
visual: Overhead view of a smaller jar of chair tokens beside two covered marketing-cost crocks. The newer crock is still under cloth; its size cannot yet be read.

text: 行銷與銷售費比前一年少近三十億美元。
visual: Close shot of a marketing worktable. An earlier dish of blue expense stones is fuller than the later dish; a different ivory ad-revenue dish sits off to the side.

text: 推廣支出下降；相關團隊人數減少，也拉低那一類人事費。
visual: CARD

text: FoA 營業利益來到約六百二十九億，比上一年明顯高。
visual: CARD

text: 可是 RL 這一欄，會跟著廣告收入的回升一起改善嗎？
visual: Close shot of a records table without documents. A tall sage green stack stands in the foreground, while the neighboring terracotta result bowl stays concealed under an opaque cloth.

text: 二〇二三年，RL 營業虧損反而擴大到約一百六十一億美元。
visual: Close shot of two brick-colored research-result vessels on a plain worktable. The later vessel hangs visibly lower than the earlier one under smooth weights, while a scale and any exact values stay out of view.

text: 公司指出兩個原因：人事費增加，以及 RL 收入減少。
visual: CARD

text: 沿著收入往下找，哪款裝置的銷量出現缺口？
visual: CARD

text: 公司說，這主要受 Meta Quest 銷量淨減少帶動。
visual: Wide view along a plain stock shelf. A generic headset shell stands beside two unmarked boxes; fewer small headset models sit in the later open box than the earlier one. A research-revenue bin is shallower.

text: 把兩欄相加，公司合計還會停在低谷嗎？
visual: Medium view of a wooden balance. A pale green stack grows on one side and a rust stone pulls lower on the other, while the central company-result dish remains completely covered.

text: 二〇二三年公司營業利益回到約四百六十八億美元。
visual: Close shot of a sage green company-result stack rising above the tabletop in a later arrangement. An older comparison stack waits a little farther away, and its exact difference remains hidden from view.

text: 兩份年報的公司合計幾乎重疊；最後那點差距，還壓在尾數下。
visual: Overhead view of two nearly equal light green stacks on a plain table. A tiny loose ceramic bead between their bases remains beneath a smooth opaque cup, concealing the small difference.

text: 兩份年報的精確合計，只差二百萬美元。
visual: Overhead view of two nearly equal pale green ceramic stacks on a blank wooden table. A tiny spacer bead between their bases is entirely hidden beneath a thick smooth opaque cup. Neither stack carries numerals or marks.

text: FoA 多賺近六十億，RL 虧損也幾乎多了同樣多，兩股變化互相抵消。
visual: CARD

text: 正是中間的低谷，讓兩個幾乎相等的端點不能被叫作「三年沒變」。
visual: Overhead view of three sage green stacks in a row. The middle stack is substantially lower, while the two outer stacks are almost level. No line or continuous path joins them.

text: 再過兩年，這種正負變化幅度相近的局面，還會出現在二〇二五年嗎？
visual: Wide view of a filing-room shelf made only of blank wood. Two closed opaque boxes from distant periods stand apart, each with a light green and brick-colored compartment under a lid; their contents await comparison.

text: 二〇二三到二〇二五兩個端點，FoA 正項增加將近四百億美元。
visual: Close shot of two pale green ceramic stacks. The later stack is substantially taller, with a rust-colored compartment visible but unopened beside it.

text: RL 虧損也加深，幅度卻只有約三十一億；兩者不再貼著走。
visual: Close shot of two comparison stations. A tall sage-green later stack stands visible while a neighboring terracotta difference bowl stays fully hidden beneath a thick opaque cover. Smooth objects with no paper or markings.

text: 這是跨兩年的端點對照，不能當成每一年都照同一方向移動。
visual: CARD

text: 二〇二五年 FoA 的成本也在增加；這次廣告收入能跑得過費用嗎？
visual: Medium view at an ad-buying counter. Many ivory revenue beads arrive in one basin while a blue operating-cost basin also grows; a sage green result basin stays under a plain cover.

text: 二〇二五年對二〇二四年，廣告送達數與平均單價這次一起往上。
visual: Overhead view of two plain market tables. At the newer table both the number of ivory ad tiles and a group of copper payment tokens have grown; the older table has smaller groups of both.

text: Meta 認為，定位與成效衡量改善，拉高廣告主需求。
visual: Medium view of a quiet market counter. A simple unlabeled measuring lens rests by a generic handset back as more anonymous buyer tokens approach the ad-tile cup. The visual suggests a company explanation, not a proved cause.

text: FoA 營業利益比前一年多約一百五十四億美元。
visual: CARD

text: 公司說更高廣告收入是主因，費用增加只抵銷其中一部分。
visual: Close shot beside the rear of a generic handset. The newer crock fills with more ivory ad-revenue beads than the older one, while a distinct light green profit crock sits at a different place on the table.

text: 基礎設施與夥伴安排費增加，抵銷部分增長。
visual: Wide view through an infrastructure aisle. Plain equipment racks and a closed partner-supply crate both contribute blue stones to a cost bin; the pale green result dish waits farther away.

text: RL 收入還包含軟體與內容；只看眼鏡和 Quest，能算出損益嗎？
visual: Medium view across a research shelf. Plain eyeglass frames, a generic headset shell, a smooth software disc and a plain content sleeve surround one shared revenue vessel. There are no product-result vessels.

text: 算不出單品損益；比前一年，AI 眼鏡銷售增加，Meta Quest 減少。
visual: Medium view of a prototype bench. Plain eyeglass frames and generic headset shells sit in separate earlier and later boxes, but every later box is closed by a snug opaque lid. Two small product-result drawers remain locked. All surfaces are smooth and unmarked.

text: 年報只給 RL 整體收入；它仍比前一年多六千一百萬美元。
visual: Overhead view of a research bench after the lids have been opened. The later box holds more plain eyeglass frames than its earlier neighbor, while a later box of generic headset shells holds fewer. Both types feed one large terracotta-colored research revenue bowl alongside smooth software discs and plain content sleeves; no individual result bowls are open.

text: 營業損益給出反轉：RL 虧損比二〇二四年擴大約十五億美元。
visual: Medium view in a quiet research room. A later terracotta result bowl hangs lower than an earlier bowl, while three distinct blue expense urns remain covered behind them. All objects are unmarked and without a scale.

text: 年報指出成本費用提高；到底是哪幾項費用推深虧損？
visual: Wide view of a research workroom. Three closed blue expense urns stand before one shared brick-colored result urn; what is inside each cost urn cannot yet be seen. The room holds only smooth plain objects and no documents.

text: 先是 RL 的人事費增加，推高整個分部的成本費用。
visual: CARD

text: 另有無法取消的庫存採購承諾，相關損失也拉高費用。
visual: Close shot inside a supply storeroom. Sealed blank component crates are committed to a future shelf, while an estimate stone rests in a rust loss dish. Cash and product-sale dishes remain untouched.

text: 技術開發成本也提高。這幾項費用一起推深了 RL 的虧損。
visual: Overhead view of a prototype bench. Additional loose technical components feed one blue development-cost basin beside people-cost and inventory-cost basins. The shared terracotta result basin sits beyond them.

text: 當年的費用已入帳；未上市產品的研發投資，何時才可能實現？
visual: Wide view through a research-room doorway. In the foreground, three cost urns rest on a plain workbench. Beyond the doorway, several unfinished smooth prototypes sit beneath opaque covers at increasing distances. The surfaces are blank.

text: 公司說，有些未上市產品的研發投資，可能到下個十年才完全實現。靠什麼支撐？
visual: Medium view down an empty research hallway. Several unfinished generic prototypes remain beneath plain cloth covers on progressively distant benches. There is no finished product at the far end.

text: 年報還說，推進下一代運算平台的努力，取決於其他業務能否創造足夠利潤。
visual: CARD

text: 這是公司層級的獲利條件，分部損益表仍沒有逐筆現金轉帳紀錄。
visual: Medium view of two physically separated shelves. A pale green company-profit crock sits above; a different closed cash crock sits below, with clear empty space and no chute or tube between them.

text: 開場那筆 RL 營業虧損近一百九十二億；FoA 同年營業利益約一千零二十五億。
visual: Wide overhead view of a worktable. A tall sage green stack and a shorter terracotta weight stand apart; a third opaque company-result compartment stays covered between them. The two positions remain visually distinct.

text: 所以答案是：兩欄相加，Meta 同年仍有約八百三十三億美元營業利益。
visual: Medium view of one complete adult office worker standing behind a bare worktable. The worker, with an attached head, neck, torso and both arms visible, lifts the lid of a plain pale-green compartment to reveal a short stack of smooth pale-green blocks. A taller sage-green stack stands on one side of the compartment and a shorter terracotta weight stands on the other side. Plain background and solid-coloured objects.

text: 如果能單獨拆開一款產品的帳，你最想選哪個？
visual: CARD

text: 訂閱品牌故事，繼續用原始資料拆開熟悉品牌的關鍵轉折。
visual: Wide view back at the opening records room. A smooth unmarked wooden cabinet closes gently as morning light falls on clear empty space beside it, ready for an end-screen animation.
